column1: # note: The 2025 Ohio Income Tax Brackets for Ohio IT 1040, on taxable nonbusiness income (line 7), entered on line 8a. Ohio prints no tax table.
# note: The brackets are the same for every filing status; they are repeated for each status the form offers.
# note: The first bracket is 0% up to $26,050; the second starts at a base tax of $342.00, so the tax rises from $0 to $342 above $26,050, as printed.
# note: The instructions round all figures to the nearest dollar (page 5).
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
